name: Limit ~Kyoukaisen~
source:
Main character gets in a traffic accident together with his sister and lover. He regains consciousness at a hospital. Ayaka regains consciousness in two days, but it turns out that she acquires personality of his sister still lying in coma... 
This way their unusual life begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与妹妹和恋人一起遭遇了交通事故。他在医院恢复了意识。两天后，绫香也醒了过来，但她似乎获得了仍躺在昏迷中的妹妹的人格……
就这样，他们不同寻常的生活开始了。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
